arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort; I watch for: (1) pod drift (pod power vs boat-model power and heart rate disagreeing) -> set pod_gain; (2) drag/weed (push_local drops within a leg, GPS speed falls at same pod power) -> clear_rudder; (3) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell distance; (4) paddler messages. Baseline the ratio boat power / pod power once settled (from ~3 min). Keep cues few; no effort cues (pacer owns effort).

arguments.name: boat_over_pod
arguments.description: boat-model power per pod watt; jumps if pod drifts or drag changes

arguments.message: local push strongly negative: weed/drag or adverse current?

arguments.reason: baseline pod vs boat power and HR once settled after start

text: no cue: start phase, pacer owns effort; set plan, a drag watch and a 3-minute wake-up to baseline.

arguments.text: Baseline 120-240 s (leg 1 out, north): pod 190 W, boat-model 124 W (boat/pod ~0.65), GPS 3.19, rate 66, HR 176 rising 2.4/min (above pod CP 174). Computer share 0.609; push +0.11 m/s outbound if share right. Pacer eased at 110 s.

arguments.message: boat-model power per pod watt moved >20% from ~0.65 baseline: pod drift, drag or current change?

arguments.reason: after first turn: measure leg 2 vs leg 1 for hull fit (share and push)

arguments.text: Hull fit legs 1-2 (120-290 out, 335-420 back): share 0.648 (0.644-0.652), push +0.05 m/s outbound. Computer share 0.622. Pod 189-190 W steady vs pod CP 174; pod reserve 13% at 7 min, HR 180 rising ~1.3-1.8/min. Boat reserve already 0 but speed holds -> boat-model CP likely low. Watch whether pod CP 174 is too low (no blow-up when pod reserve hits 0).

arguments.message: pod reserve near empty: does pod power hold (CP higher than test) or collapse?
pod power dropped below 160 W: blow-up, easing, or pod drift?
